<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>User account is disabled</span></div>

## Why it happens

- An administrator disabled the account, or
- the user was created but never activated: they did not open the activation link, so no password was set.

## Fix it

An administrator opens **Users**, finds the user and either enables the account or sends the activation link again. If e-mail does not work, the administrator can use **Copy activation link** and pass the link on.

## Check that it worked

The user can sign in.
